    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (float, int)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must be 2D matrices")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if n_candidates == 0 or future_horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must not be empty")
    for arr in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call):
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Log probabilities must be nonpositive")

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw / raw.sum()

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (negative weighted log probs)
    L_plus = - (logp_with_result @ weights)
    L_call_only = - (logp_call_only @ weights)
    L_no_call = - (logp_no_call @ weights)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Margin and keep mask
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
